correctness.rationale: For zero-hopping two-site equal-energy thermal Holstein instance, displacement overlaps give L_inf=exp(-2a coth(beta omega/2)). Averaging the shared oscillator phase difference evaluates the exact integral exp(-2ac/R) I0(2a csch(beta omega/2)/R). Multiplication of R independent copies gives L_R; I0(z)=1+z²/4+O(z⁴) yields R times trace-distance error -> L_inf a² csch²(beta omega/2)>0 when a>0, beta finite. Independently checked phase integral numerically R=1,2,10,100 to within 3e-16; this does not substitute for displacement proof. Zero-temperature limit gives exact cancellation.
